svg.text: OmniSync-style mask-free lip sync (arXiv 2505.21448) + target-face control for multi-face scenes
M_t soft target mask (face+jaw, dilated, feathered) · (x_m, y_m)_t mouth center · p_t presence
→ also resampled to latent grid: ÷4 time, ÷8 space (M_lat, mouth_lat)
③ Generator — one window at a time
per-window bus: V_src frames · A_tgt audio · prompt · M_t / M_lat · (x_m, y_m)_t
velocity v_θ(x_t, z_cond, A, c, σ)
same ε as PNI → non-target faces
boundary band freed last k steps
FID · FVD · CSIM · NIQE · BRISQUE · HyperIQA
⑤ Variant: wilro-sync-lite (reference K/V) — built after the main model
run ONCE per window at σ = 0
reused by all steps & CFG passes
→ reference cross-attn to mapped Wan K,V (new)
decode crop → paste into full frame
main model: 50 steps × 2 (CFG) × Wan-1.3B ≈ 100 large passes
lite: 1 Wan pass + 100 × Lip DiT (≈0.45B) ≈ ~3× faster
trade-off: smaller generator prior → some quality loss; leakage risk via cache
